svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 700 mm lengths of 45 x 45 mm treated timber.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Coach bolt holes: 9 mm through, side to side, 15 mm up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rail's bottom face, 285 mm each side of the middle (one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Panel bolt holes: drill 6.5 mm down through the rail where the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel frame's own mounting holes fall (about 400 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the panel's centre line on each long side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the panel's aluminium frame sits on the two rails; M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts through the frame and rail, washers and nuts below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rails slope at 15 degrees, the panel tilt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two rails are the same length and drilled alike.
